{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''Trunskan police force''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] body made of of [[Trunsk]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trunska]]. The police force came into being upon the orders of [[Tyl]] the Deplorable, the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who conquered all of Trunska; formerly, its membership had been [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in his [[Army/Legends|armies]]. These police worked for the Trunsk [[Emperor/Legends|emperor]] and enforced the laws of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], these laws required the Trunskan police to crack down on anyone carrying personal weapons or piloting armed [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
